retention.band: DERIVED, not measured: max(|PLANr - PLAN per-scenario pooled SLU delta|, 1.2485 pp), the floor being the registered pooled own-null SLU-F1 micro CI95 half-width. It is a decision rule for pruning and no claim may treat it as a per-scenario null.
retention.rule: owner decision 83 as preregistered: RETIRE when every targeted scenario is harmed beyond its own band; KEEP when any targeted scenario gains beyond it; otherwise the frontier-slope tie rule keeps a row only if its own per-delta paired SLU mean over the rows it reached exceeds 0.0 pp.

prompt_fit_bound.basis: MEASURED on the committed tree by core.flight.cli check (exit 0 on all eight cells), whose _assess_prompt_budget bounds each phase by the WORST CASE the supplied stores can render, not by a prediction. The bound is identical to CELL-1's to the token, because it is driven by the per-node CAPS and the LONGEST statement (126 characters at both versions), neither of which the retention moves; what version 2 lowers is the worst-case supplied characters per node (476 / 850 / 416 / 269 against v1r's 485 / 938 / 423 / 381) and, on the realised requests, the number of rows at which a candidate-bound route fills its cap.
prompt_fit_bound.compaction_is_a_reported_diagnostic: cell PLAN's own sealed run compacted ZERO rows (analysis/SAEA-SLURP-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-PAIRED-ANALYSIS-V1/compaction.json). The four-row smoke reads its own E20 receipts and the verdict carries the compacted-row count per phase beside cell PLAN's 0. A non-zero count is a cost and a caveat on the frontier row's token basis, not a failure.
prompt_fit_bound.decision: ALLOW on perception, reviewer and planner. The SOLVER phase's worst-case bound is COMPACT_REQUIRED by 317 tokens against the live slot minus its one-eighth reserve (24,576 - 3,072). That is a BOUND, not a prediction: it assumes every supplied store renders its cap at its longest on one row. The episode declares context_fit_policy 'compact-or-abstain', so a Solver request that really does exceed the window is COMPACTED, never truncated, and every compaction is counted in the E20 receipts. core.flight.cli check reports no blocker and authorises the cell.

measured_bound_per_phase.smoke_cells: identical to the hundred: reviewer 19,855, planner 19,794, solver 21,820

prompt_fit_bound.no_comparator_bound_was_measurable: the same bound could not be taken for cell PLAN: contracts.gate_exposure refuses core.flight.cli check on a run whose exposure row is consumed ('a consumed run cannot be re-executed'), which is correct and is why the empirical reference above is PLAN's sealed REALISED prefill rather than its bound.
prompt_fit_bound.the_authority_in_flight: core.preparation_fit.build_native_contact_fit_gate fits every realised immutable request against the resident tokenizer before it is transmitted and STOPS the flight rather than truncating. No static bound in this package replaces it.

supply_reach.what_it_means: Every value of the released store is reachable on every node, arm and twin, exactly as at v1r. The routes are therefore not inert by construction. What the retention DOES change is how often a candidate-bound route finds a match at all: CELL-1 measured the Planner route at 0.594 of rows supplied and 1.259 items per supplied row against a cap of 4, and version 2 keeps 4 of its 14 Planner values over 4 distinct intents. The four-row smoke measures the realised per-node supplied counts before the arm opens, and the verdict reports the Planner route separately rather than pooled.
supply_reach.what_this_is: A MODEL-FREE upper bound on what each candidate-bound route can ever select, computed by intersecting each value's associated_facet_ids with the 60 registered SLURP candidate intents of prepared/SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-CANDIDATE-CONTRACTS-PREPARE-V1/catalog.json. Measured on the released version-2 snapshots by scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas_steps.py reach and written into coordination/slurp-stage3-delta-cell-r02-v1/stage3-deltas-v2-release-pins.json.
